describe.description: A large upright creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. The upper body, head, wings and legs are those of a brown eagle with dense layered brown plumage, a hooked beak and yellow scaly feet with black talons, while the rear where a bird's tail would be is replaced by a cluster of thick fleshy tentacles bearing rows of circular suckers that hang down and curl at the tips. The creature stands on two feathered legs with its wings folded against its sides, and sucker-like circular markings are also visible on the skin of the lower torso and thighs integrated with the feathers.

describe.description: The creature is a large brown bird of prey standing in profile facing right. It has the head, hooked beak, feathered body, folded wings, and yellow taloned feet of an eagle, covered in dense brown plumage. From its rear underside where a tail would be hangs a cluster of long tapering octopus-like tentacles lined with pale suckers, and patches of suckered octopus-like skin are also visible among the feathers on its lower body and thighs.
